capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned tempo block 42451876 (hash 0x4e12ac0ec8edd0fb16ac606874c0e9ebb4e3b5e7e154340ac54e6cce77beae9c). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Tempo runtime is byte-for-byte identical to the verified Ethereum senPYUSDmain runtime after replacing only six embedded immutable asset addresses; both deployment hashes are pinned. Inherited controls concern pathusd-bridge, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

Rechecked 2026-10-03 at the same pin: owner and curator each have threshold 1 and one owner; getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) reaches sentinel 0x1 with no modules. addAdapter and increaseAbsoluteCap delays are 259200s; setPerformanceFee, setManagementFee and setSendAssetsGate delays are zero.
